subject: English First Additional Language

source.subtopic: Recognises onset and rime in more complex patterns (dr-eam, cr-eam, scr-eam, str-eam)

show.line: Dream, cream, scream, stream! The end is the same. Only the start changes.

rounds.prompt: Change cr to dr in cream. What do we get?

hints: Look at the end. It stays the same.
Change the start to make a new word.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! I will make a new word from dream.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Drum does not end like dream. Cream does.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's listen together. Dream, cream. Same ending!

parent_line: Can change the start of a word to make new words: dream, cream, stream.
